result_text:
Overlapping bookings for the same master are now blocked at the database, so the race can't produce two confirmed bookings across app servers. I couldn't run the integration tests here because Postgres and Redis aren't running, so the new test is unverified.

The change is in `createBooking` in `src/lib/booking.ts`. Inside its transaction, it now locks the master's `staff` row (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), then checks for a confirmed booking that overlaps the requested time. If it finds one, it returns `slot_taken`, which the existing route already maps to a `409`. Checkouts for the same master are serialised by that row lock, and checkouts for different masters don't block each other. Cancelled, completed and no-show bookings are ignored by the overlap check. The waitlist accept path goes through the same function, so it's covered too. Admin status changes can't set a booking back to `confirmed`, so this is the only path that creates confirmed bookings.

I also added an integration test in `src/lib/booking.integration.test.ts`. It races 20 checkouts with overlapping start times for one master and expects exactly one success.

`pnpm test` passes, `pnpm build` succeeds, and ESLint is clean on the changed files. `tsc --noEmit` reports one error in `src/app/layout.tsx`, which I didn't touch. Changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
